## raw() function

Mark a value as literal SQL so it is emitted verbatim instead of being quoted.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export declare function raw(value: string): RawExpression;
```

</td><td>

SQL text, e.g. `"CURRENT_TIMESTAMP"`<!-- -->. Interpolating untrusted input here is an injection vector — the text is not escaped.


</td></tr>
</tbody></table>

**Returns:**

[RawExpression](./database.rawexpression.md)

An expression the grammars emit as-is.

## Example


```ts
table.timestamp('created_at').default(raw('CURRENT_TIMESTAMP'))
```
